title: Paloma Rewards Tier Qualification Thresholds
content:
Each Paloma Rewards tier has two qualifying thresholds measured over the trailing 12 months: a count of qualifying transfers and, as an alternative, a qualifying principal volume in USD. A member meets a tier when either one of the two is reached.

## Tier thresholds

| Tier | Qualifying transfers in the trailing 12 months | Or qualifying principal volume in the trailing 12 months (USD) | Smallest principal a transfer must carry (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Paloma Rewards Blue | 0 | 0.00 | 25.00 |
| Paloma Rewards Silver | 6 | 3000.00 | 25.00 |
| Paloma Rewards Gold | 12 | 7500.00 | 25.00 |
| Paloma Rewards Platinum | 24 | 15000.00 | 25.00 |
| Paloma Rewards Diamond | 36 | 30000.00 | 25.00 |
| Paloma Rewards Elite | 52 | 60000.00 | 25.00 |

The smallest principal in the last column is the floor a transfer must reach both to earn points and to count toward a tier.

## What counts as a qualifying transfer

A qualifying transfer is one of the member's own personal transfers (Bank Deposit, Cash Pickup or Mobile Wallet) that:

- carries a principal at or above the smallest principal shown for the tier;
- reached deposited (Bank Deposit), paid out (Cash Pickup) or credited (Mobile Wallet) within the window; and
- has not been refunded.

The window is the trailing 12 calendar months: a transfer counts when its delivery date falls on or after the same calendar day 12 months before the handling date. The qualifying principal volume is the total USD principal (the send amount in USD) of those same qualifying transfers.

## Points of judgement

- Count and volume are alternatives. A member with 10 qualifying transfers totalling USD 8000.00 does not reach Paloma Rewards Gold by count (10 is below 12) but reaches it by volume (8000.00 is at least 7500.00); the same member reaches neither threshold of Paloma Rewards Platinum (10 is below 24 and 8000.00 is below 15000.00).
- The principal floor is inclusive. With the 25.00 USD floor, a transfer of exactly 25.00 USD counts; a transfer of 24.99 USD does not count toward either threshold.
- The window boundary is inclusive. Taking a hypothetical handling date of 4 October 2026, a transfer delivered on 4 October 2025 is inside the window and one delivered on 3 October 2025 is outside it.
- A refunded transfer is left out of both the count and the volume, even when it had been delivered inside the window.
- Paloma Rewards Blue needs no qualifying transfers: its thresholds are 0 transfers and 0.00 USD.
